title-group.article-title: Crystal structure of a Mycobacterium tuberculosis kinase

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Kinases are important. This paragraph must not be treated as methods.

sec.title: Materials and Methods
sec.p: Cells were lysed in 50 mM Tris pH 8.0 with 300 mM NaCl.

sec.title: Protein purification
sec.p: The lysate was applied to Ni-NTA resin and eluted with 250 mM imidazole.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: The structure was solved at 2.1 A.

sec.title: Purification of the selenomethionine derivative
sec.p: SeMet protein was purified over a HiLoad Superdex 200 column.
